docs: Products content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of products, each with a picture, a name as a link and the price as it is shown. One object is valid in every products layout (three or four columns, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the products, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the product picture; none: the placeholder

title.docs: the name of the product (the alt text of the picture)

price.docs: the price as it is shown

href.docs: the address of the product; none: the name is plain text
